item.title: Fire out and shelter-in-place order is lifted after oil refinery explosion near Texas coast
item.description: An oil refinery fire near the Texas coast was put out Tuesday and a shelter-in-place order was lifted, hours after a large explosion at the complex shot plumes of smoke into the air, officials said.

item.title: Update on West Kelowna water order expected Wednesday
item.description: On Monday, city staff conducted a reservoir inspection and cleaning. Once the cleaning is complete and the test results indicate there is no contamination, the reservoir will be refilled.

item.title: B.C. mulls changes to weaken DRIPA, shares secret document with First Nations leaders
item.description: British Columbia Premier David Eby's government is considering amendments that would weaken a landmark reconciliation law that says the province will take "all measures" to align the rights of Indigenous Peoples with existing provincial legislation..

item.title: Oil prices rise and stocks fall as war with Iran advances despite Trump
item.description: With airstrikes still battering Iran and missiles still targeting sites across the Middle East, some of the optimism that sent stocks rallying the day before drained out of Wall Street on Tuesday. Oil prices got back to rising, and U.S. stocks are returning some of their gains.

item.title: Iran dismisses US ceasefire plan, issues counterproposal as strikes land across the Mideast
item.description: UPDATE: 8:05 a.m. Iran on Wednesday dismissed an American plan to pause the war in the Middle East and launched more attacks on Israel and Gulf Arab countries, including an assault that sparked a huge fire at Kuwait International Airport.
